description: Spelling Quiz sets: small focused groups. 'bones' are bone ids; a set may use one side only. 'statement' is shown when the set is mastered in a session.

sets.title: The 8 cranial bones
sets.statement: You can now name the 8 cranial bones from the front, the side and behind.

sets.title: The 14 facial bones
sets.statement: You can now name all 14 facial bones from every side.

sets.title: The 3 ossicles of the middle ear
sets.statement: You can now name the three ossicles of the middle ear.

sets.title: The 7 cervical vertebrae
sets.statement: You can now name the 7 cervical vertebrae, from the atlas down to C7.

sets.title: Lumbar vertebrae, sacrum and coccyx
sets.statement: You can now name the lumbar vertebrae, the sacrum and the coccyx.

sets.title: The sternum and the 7 true ribs
sets.statement: You can now name the sternum and the seven true ribs.

sets.title: Shoulder girdle, arm and forearm
sets.statement: You can now name the bones of the shoulder girdle, arm and forearm.

sets.title: The 8 carpal bones
sets.statement: You can now name all 8 carpal bones from every side.

sets.title: The 5 metacarpals
sets.statement: You can now name the five metacarpals.

sets.title: Pelvis and lower limb
sets.statement: You can now name the bones of the pelvis and lower limb.

sets.title: The 7 tarsal bones
sets.statement: You can now name all 7 tarsal bones from every side.
